en: Multi-view color postcard with five images of landmarks from a European city. The top left shows a charming pedestrian street lined with historic buildings, cafes, and outdoor seating. The top right depicts a large Romanesque cathedral with four towers and a statue in front. The center right shows a stone mosque-like building with a prominent green dome. The bottom left has a monumental fountain or statue group with a central standing figure and two seated figures. The bottom right shows an ornate baroque/neo-baroque theater or opera house with domes and decorative facades. The word "PÉCS" is printed in large green letters across the lower left image.
